name: Rüzgâr Gülü
scene: A four-bladed folded pinwheel on a straight stick turns amid sweeping wind ribbons inside an oval stained-glass panel.
notes: Design sheet only; target 80–120 panes. Warm alternating blade folds, circular hub and segmented stick contrast with cool wind ribbons. Original subject: assets/glass/motif_pinwheel-silhouette.webp; style references: vitray_fox.png and vitray_lighthouse.png. Generated and visually inspected, then regenerated once to improve closed band subdivisions, crowded junctions and white exterior. Final sheet inspected: semantic colour pairs are preserved and no obvious loose line ends; remaining concerns include subtle fill shading, some crowded multiway contacts along blade fold seams and narrow tapered wind regions. Exact pane count, junction separation and flat palette require tracing-stage validation; this is not audited playable geometry.
